intro: The Brass Collar is a sturdy neckpiece worn by Princess, a prize-winning sow owned by the Brackwell family. It serves as tangible proof for Ma Stonefield that the gluttonous beast has been put down before ruining her farm's crops.

p: Princess is no ordinary swine; she is an enormous, ribbon-worthy pig belonging to the Brackwell family who roams around their pumpkin patch east of the Maclure homestead. Unfortunately for her neighbors, her prize-winning size is fueled by a ravenous appetite for the crops at the Stonefield Farm. Tired of losing her valuable vegetables to the wandering glutton, Ma Stonefield seeks someone willing to slay the massive sow. Because Princess wears a prominent brass band around her neck, her collar serves as undeniable proof that the marauding pig will never raid the Stonefield fields again.
